recipes.label: The End of Immortality?
recipes.startdescription:
Immortality—a fragile lie. With enough wounds, any existence can be slain... and I am no exception.

[Too late! If you still have at least three wounds before the timer ends, you will die!]

recipes.label: Wake-Tremor!
recipes.startdescription:
The roots of the Wake tremble from the power of war, and here, the skin of the world flaps in sickly, disordered ripples. Nothing here can operate entirely as 'normal'—

[Allied units, Tools, or abilities drawn in enter cooldown. Non-immortal allies will be consumed.]
recipes.description: It is over, for now. The tattered skin seems able to hold on a little longer, though I suspect the day of its end is coming.

recipes.startdescription: There will always be moments like this—moments when the wheel of fate spins backward. The malice of this world has been roused, and it will manifest in some form.

recipes.label: Power Rises
recipes.startdescription: At last, the vast machinery of the world has turned to the right position; clear power rises from a deeper source. What enlightenment will come to me today? What breakthrough might it bring?
recipes.description: I have been stronger than this, more glorious; but even this shall suffice to make those who scorn me regret it.

recipes.label: Restless Thoughts
recipes.startdescription:
They say dreams are reflections of the light of the Watchman. If that is true, then my well‑shielded mind should be free of dreams. Yet I still dream. If I do not use this chance to contemplate something, I shall dream of my own past and deeper longings…

[Place a Desire card and a specific Opportunity card to transform the Desire. If no cards are placed, you will receive random dreams and outcomes.]
